profile.description:
Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 is built for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work, extending Claude Fable 5 with stronger long-running agentic coding, multistep research, and document, spreadsheet, and slide work.

Its 1M-token context window and image understanding suit large codebases, extensive documents, and multimodal analysis. Adaptive thinking is always on, steerable from low to max effort.
